posts.description: Although I generally know The US Constitution and can name most of the 10 Bill of Rights and a few of the later amendments, The Declaration of Independence is not something I've thought about or read in a very long time.

posts.title: Meshtastic and Meshcore in the Pacific Northwest
posts.description: A hot topic on “Teh Socials” over the past six months has been Meshtastic. Just this past week, I've had four separate conversations about Meshtastic, Meshcore, and the small mesh radios that power these networks.
